evidence.quote: I believe the time to lower the policy rate is drawing closer.
In this scenario, I could envision a rate cut in the not-too-distant future.
The recent data are making me more confident we will achieve the inflation goal of our dual mandate.
As of today, I see there is more upside risk to unemployment than we have seen for a long time.
Clearly, economic activity among these businesses is slowing, but it is too soon to say by how much.
Monthly PCE inflation has very recently been running near 2 percent at an annual rate, but I need to see a bit more evidence that this will be sustained.

parsed.rationale: The speaker signals that rate cuts are approaching, citing reassuring inflation data, a labor market back in balance, and greater upside risk to unemployment. This dovish lean is tempered by a data-dependent caution about needing a bit more evidence before cutting.
